chunks: And watch; they will come to know soon.

key_terms.يُبْصِرُونَ: They will perceive or come to know

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And watch; they will come to know soon' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse is often interpreted as a command to the Prophet Muhammad (or the believers) to observe the disbelievers' futile efforts, with the promise that they will soon perceive the reality of the divine message. Shia exegesis highlights this as a reassurance of ultimate victory for the faithful, emphasizing that divine truth will manifest clearly to those who remain steadfast. The phrase underscores the transient nature of worldly power compared to the enduring clarity of divine guidance.
